text:
Which statement about alkali metals is correct?
A
Lithium is more dense than sodium.
B
Sodium is more reactive than potassium.
C
Sodium has a higher melting point than potassium.
D
They are in Group II of the Periodic Table.

options.label: A
options.text: Lithium is more dense than sodium.

options.label: B
options.text: Sodium is more reactive than potassium.

options.label: C
options.text: Sodium has a higher melting point than potassium.

options.label: D
options.text: They are in Group II of the Periodic Table.
